note: The English quotes the Open Word Bible (OWB, Balanced). This Ukrainian edition quotes Kulish 1905 (ebible ukr_pan, via the GitHub mirror) instead: every passage inside quotation marks presented as Scripture was spliced by script from that text in its own orthography, and where Kulish words a verse differently the author's surrounding sentence was rebuilt around Kulish's words. Mined rows were machine-checked as verbatim substrings of the Kulish verse (or its neighbour, for Kulish's one-off numbering).

self_rendered rows are the reader's own prayers built on a verse (Luke 11:1 'teach me', Matthew 26:39 'let this pass'; ch15's reader prayers echoing John 11:41 carry no quotation marks and no row) where Kulish's wording could not carry the person or tense, plus Luke 5:16's «Він же», which is Kulish's but is carried in prose. Voices from the past are pasted from the shipped uk editions where one exists (Murray, Bounds's Power Through Prayer / Necessity of Prayer, Spurgeon, Moody); Watson, Torrey, Müller and Bounds's Reality of Prayer have no uk edition and are translated.

Points for the native reviewer: 1 Thess 5:18 (Kulish «За все дякуйте» vs the author's 'in everything': a short gloss on the Greek was added); Jonah 2:9 is Kulish 2:10; Luke 23:34's second half (the dividing of the garments) is absent from the mirrored Kulish text; Kulish's Luke 11:2-4 is the long form although ch04 calls it 'the shorter form'; Matthew 18:22 Kulish 'seventy times seven' vs OWB 'seventy-seven'; John 21:15-17 Kulish has «Паси» three times (OWB Feed/Shepherd/Feed).
